latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of addiction-self-assessment: honest, stigma-free screening and harm reduction guidance for substance use and behavioral addictions.

- Includes self-assessment questions plus validated clinical tools (CAGE, AUDIT) for alcohol and substance use.
- Provides jurisdiction-aware guidance for treatment, helplines, harm reduction, and support options worldwide.
- Covers both substances and compulsive behaviors (gambling/gaming).
- Emphasizes actionable, non-judgmental support and practical steps for seeking help affordably.
